meetings.title: Incident review - payments outage
meetings.transcript:
Dev: Thanks everyone. Timeline first. Alerts fired at 14:02, we declared at 14:10, mitigated at 14:47.
Ines: The root cause was the expired TLS cert on the payment gateway proxy.
Nobody got the renewal email because it went to a distribution list that was deleted.
Dev: Right. So action items. First, cert expiry monitoring.
Ines: Put me down for that. I'll have an alert for any cert expiring within 30 days by end of next week.
Dev: Thanks Ines. Second, we need an owner for the distribution list cleanup.
Kofi: I can take that, but it might slip past Friday because of the audit.
Dev: That's fine. Third, the runbook didn't mention the proxy at all.
Ines: Yeah, I'll update the runbook too.
Kofi: Should we also look at moving to managed certificates?
Dev: Let's not decide that today. Kofi, can you write up the pros and cons for next Wednesday's review?
Kofi: Sure.
Dev: And I'll send the postmortem draft to the exec team by Friday.
Ines: One more thing, we're blocked on getting access to the CA dashboard, security still hasn't granted it.
Dev: I'll chase security. Okay, thanks all.

actions.action: write up pros and cons of managed certificates
send the postmortem draft to execs
chase security for CA dashboard access
